subject.title: feat: add live-validated Zoom meeting guest plugin

question: Should Zoom guest joining, automatic browser media permissions, and configured BlackHole/SoX command execution ship as a bundled OpenClaw plugin rather than an externally distributed official plugin?
rationale: The implementation follows existing meeting-plugin patterns, but deciding whether this new privileged integration is bundled is a maintainer product and security-boundary choice that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Approve bundled Zoom support
options.body: Accept the new disabled-by-default bundled plugin after reviewing its privilege boundary and receiving inspectable live evidence.

options.title: Publish as an external official plugin
options.body: Keep the generic meeting runtime seam and distribute Zoom-specific browser, selector, and audio behavior outside the core bundle.

options.title: Pause for a narrower transport design
options.body: Defer the feature until maintainers choose a lower-privilege or better-supported Zoom integration boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled Zoom support
recommendation.body: Accept the new disabled-by-default bundled plugin after reviewing its privilege boundary and receiving inspectable live evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR history and the dependency-guard context connect this person most directly to the proposed meeting-plugin and security-boundary design.
